messages:
harper: Noticed us-west p95 popped ~200ms during the canary. Dashboard p95 marker jumped but sample_count for /v1/embed was 9 in that 1m bucket. Link: https://redwood.internal/screens/def456
ayana: low samples again. Are we still applying the 90s decaying smooth? That can produce a transient step if fallback rollup switches.
matt: checking metric store now, grabbing samples for that interval.
oliver: FYI we switch to histogram fallback when tdigest sample sketch < 25. Hist fallback can show quantization if buckets are coarse.
sre-jen: can you paste the raw samples? want to see if it's a single big outlier or a distribution shift.
harper: dump:
```
window: 2026-03-24T11:04Z
endpoint: /v1/embed
region: us-west-2
sample_count: 9
latencies_ms: [12, 15, 16, 18, 19, 21, 23, 350, 360]
serialized_rollup_p95: 360
raw_p95: 360
```
ayana: that's clearly dominated by two outliers. With n=9 p95 == max of top ~1 sample depending on definition. The smoothing then propagated a visible bump across 3 windows.
product-julia: For the console UX, can we show an inline "confidence" tag next to percentile values: high/medium/low based on sample_count thresholds? People interpret p95 as authoritative.
matt: propose thresholds: sample_count < 20 -> low confidence, 20-200 -> medium, >200 -> high.
oliver: +1. Also propose exposing both tdigest p95 and raw-sample p95 when sample_count < 200, with a small info icon.
sre-jen: For alerts: gate the p95 SLO alerts so they don't fire for windows with sample_count < 25. We had a noisy alert during the canary that was just a sampling artifact.
ayana: Another idea: when sample_count < 30, switch the displayed percentile to an order-statistic view e.g., show the k-th sample with percentile rank and mark it as "empirical" so users know it's not smoothed.
harper: implementation note: telemetry already stores raw sample arrays for warm buckets; retrieving them for UI will increase payloads. We can lazy-load raw samples on demand (click reveal) instead of always showing.
product-julia: UX: show badge "low confidence - samples = 9" and tooltip: "Percentile estimates unstable for small sample sizes. Click to view raw samples and sample histogram."
oliver: also change smoothing to avoid carrying forward one-off region failovers: if sample_count < 50 and previous window had 0 for that region, reduce smoothing weight to 0 for that immediate transition.
sre-jen: action for monitoring: ENG-PLAT-1483 - "Percentile confidence and alert gating" assigned to ayana, due 2026-03-31. devex-bot: created ENG-PLAT-1483 and added to tracker.
ayana: I'll sketch design tomorrow: (1) confidence badges and thresholds, (2) lazy raw-sample reveal on click, (3) alert gating rule, (4) smoothing tweak.
harper: will prototype telemetry flag to include raw sample checksum and sample_count cheaply so UI can decide whether to lazy fetch.
matt: sounds good. I'll annotate the canary timeline to mark this as sampling artifact and silence the alert.
product-julia: I'll update the rollout docs to recommend using median for SLOs on low volume routes and adding a note about percentiles instability during regional failovers.
oliver: will follow up with a small PR to the console to show both tdigest and empirical p95 when count < 200.
harper: :thumbsup: thanks team.
